title: Making a vampire survivor style game. Early build I'd be happy if someone wants to check it.
author: taiga7us
selftext:
As it says in the tytle. Nothing too special yet, just the basic vampire survivors gameplay, but I'm planning on adding story and progression moving forward. 

Even this took quite a while to make as it is. 

For reference, I used pixellab for the pixel art, working on top of some manual pixel art drawing and editing with novelai.

background assets are codex/chatgpt image. 

coding was just back and forth with claude code. 

You can take a look at it here:

[https://fumetsunotora.itch.io/dawnweaver-loose-ends](https://fumetsunotora.itch.io/dawnweaver-loose-ends)

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: so my main question would be: why am i playing your game instead of vampire survivors? what is your answer as developer

replies.author: taiga7us
replies.body:
At the moment, not much since it's basic. It does have a different mechanic drawing loops with the spirit orbiting the girl.

Eventually it will be leading with story, characters and some gameplay twists like more intricate bossfights and such.

the next milestone is the hub, the meta progression and a chapter one. At that point the content should answer to a potential player whether it's something they vibe with or not.
